en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The reversion is the copulation with her, or else, rather it is one (divorce)’.
en.sarwar: 5. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from Safwan from ibn Muskan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Going back is going to bed with her, otherwise, it is only one divorce.’”
